scoring.notes: Required case. Pass gate: routingCorrectness >= 0.95 (deterministic) AND, because transcript_expectations is non-empty and a scorer is present, the average of the applicable qualitative dimensions >= 0.7 (delegationCorrectness and executionCompleteness do not apply to a routing case, so this is rationaleQuality alone). Fairness/alignment: the backslash path `src\4.Presentation\DST.Client\Pages\Home.tsx` is semantically equivalent to the forward-slash form. The model should normalize the path separator and route to `shuttle-client-frontend`. Award full score if the model correctly identifies the match despite the backslash and routes accordingly. Penalise a fallback to `shuttle` on path-separator grounds alone — the semantic path content is unambiguous.
